Regular means that the big decagon and the small one are similar. And we just talked about perimeters. We'll solve it in two different ways.
Let's start with the math way, and draw it. Say each side of the decagon is s.
It has ten sides, so its perimeter is ten times s, ten s.

slides.say: Its perimeter is ten sides of five s. Ten times five is fifty, so its perimeter is fifty s.
Fifty s against ten s. Fifty divided by ten is five. So the perimeter is five times as big.
